backend/main.mo: Main actor defining user, ritual, love-language, challenge, and storage-related types while mixing in authorization, blob storage, and migration support.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module defining legacy data types and a no-op run() function that returns the provided state unchanged.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a single frontend update requirement referencing useQueries.ts and associated components and tests.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files, describing their purpose, UI behavior, logic, hooks, and styling.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS variables and theme definitions for light/dark modes with global styling tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point defining metadata, viewport settings, theme color, and loading the React app root and main script.
frontend/QA_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md: Manual QA checklist outlining verification steps for versioning, theming, modals, authentication, pairing, and other core flows.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component handling authentication, profile setup flow, navigation between tabs, and layout rendering.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Renders a fixed bottom navigation bar with icons and labels, highlighting the active tab and handling tab changes.
frontend/src/components/CompletionAnimat: Displays floating animated heart icons using memoized random positions and delays.
frontend/src/components/DataStates.tsx: Provides reusable loading, empty, error, section header, and inline loading UI components with optional actions and icons.
frontend/src/components/HarmonyBreakdown: Shows current harmony score, trend visualization, and explanations using normalized trend data and color indicators.
A compact harmony summary button displaying percentage and trend, navigating users to detailed insights.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Handles login/logout via Internet Identity with loading states and error recovery, updating React Query cache.
frontend/src/components/LoveChallenges.t: Static card announcing upcoming love challenges with decorative icons.
frontend/src/components/OurLoveLanguages: Card summarizing love languages status with primary and secondary actions, supporting loading and highlight states.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: User profile setup form capturing a name, showing success or error states, and triggering initialization via mutation.
frontend/src/components/RewardVisuals.ts: Displays placeholder progress visuals with a heart-shaped meter, milestones, and a progress bar for future challenge tracking.
frontend/src/components/SpinWheel.tsx: Implements a spinning wheel that selects a random love language, including easing animation, localStorage persistence, and quiz-state integration.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: Provides a button to switch between light and dark themes using the theme context.
frontend/src/components/UnlockPacks.tsx: Shows unlockable love‑language‑themed activity packs based on streaks, allowing selection and viewing of activities.
frontend/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx: Defines a theme context handling light, dark, and system modes with persistence and system preference syncing.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity login, state management, and persistence via an authentication context using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines many React Query hooks for user profiles, admin checks, pairing, rituals, photos, and insights using a backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Re‑exports the useTheme hook from ThemeContext for compatibility.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind and CSS variables setup defining light/dark themes, fonts, dialog styling, and animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React root, sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, and renders the app.
frontend/src/pages/Activities.tsx: Renders the activities page, gating access by authentication and pairing, and displays challenges, rewards, and a spin wheel.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Implements the daily ritual flow, including fetching prompts, submitting responses, showing history, and rendering animations.
frontend/src/pages/Insights.tsx: Displays relationship insights, streaks, harmony metrics, trends, and badge milestones with admin-aware gating.
frontend/src/pages/LoveLanguages.tsx: Implements a multi‑question love languages quiz with UI mappings, scoring, backend integration, and save/reset flows.
frontend/src/pages/Memories.tsx: Displays ritual history entries with expandable details, formatted dates, love‑language tagging, and photo‑enabled responses.
frontend/src/pages/Us.tsx: Handles partner pairing, profile checks, admin state, and displays shared insights including combined love‑language results.
frontend/src/utils/harmony.ts: Provides helpers for converting harmony scores to percentages, normalizing trend series, and generating trend labels/icons.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash‑based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme colors, typography, container settings, animations, and extended utilities.
project_state.json: Contains versioned project metadata and detailed notes on architecture, frontend/backend structure, cross-cutting mixins, and design systems. Also lists known issues with backend logic, authorization gaps, frontend stubs, configuration bugs, and UI inconsistencies.
